name: A long weekend on South Molle Island
description:
Fancy a long weekend in the Whitsunday's? There are 3 spots available to spend the weekending walking, exploring, paddling, MTB'ing, snorkelling or relaxing on South Molle Island. 

How much and what you do is up to you! There are numerous tracks on the island suitable for walking and MTBing which we intend to cover,  as well as shoreline and reef to explore.

We will be departing Shute harbour mid morning on Sat 26/1 and return to Shute in the evening (approx 6pm TBC) on Monday 28/1.  

Cost: $65pp for return boat fare + $5pp visitor fee (if applicable) + camping fees (approx $15pp)

You will need to fully self sufficient in terms of camping equipment/food etc.

Members and visitors welcome to come and spots will be allocated on a first in basis.
To register or for more info please contact tsvbush@hotmail.com

name: Walk: Paluma Dam to Big Crystal Creek +/- some side trips
description:
First walk of the year - let's head to Paluma where it should be a bit cooler and enjoy the lushness of the rainforest.
Walk plan (subject to change depending on attendees): 
* Paluma Dam to Big Crystal Creek Falls
* +/-Gold Creek Falls
* +/- Blue Lagoon
* +/- Rock Garden
There will very likely be stops for photography along the way.

This walk is suitable for all walkers (pending discussion with walk leader). New walkers welcome. Walk leader is Keith.
 
For more details and to RSVP please:
* Club members and past visitors - contact Keith (details in email sent 2/1)
* New visitors - contact the Club via email tsvbush@hotmail.com

Cost: $5 for all visitors

Happy Walking in 2019!

NB: RSVP'ing to this event is not an RSVP to the walk. You MUST contact the walk leader to register your interest.
